Fantastic pedestal for our Speed Queen front load dryer. It’s stable, silent and a perfect fit. Was easy to assemble, good size drawer and good rubber dampers for the dryer to sit on.
The riser is made well, easy to assemble, sturdy and makes doing laundry so much easier with a front loader.
Product is exactly as described. It fit my washer as stated and we are very happy with our purchase
The dryer pedestal was easy to assemble, very strong and well made.

The stand is well made with quality in mind. My only criticism, however, is it should have included a solid top to sit within the frame. My front loader is smaller than the frame, causing a lot of vibration. It has raised the washing machine higher off the floor making it easier to load, which was the reason for the purchase. I have added some anti vibration pads and two timber planks to help with the vibrations, with these additions, have reduced this. I will be adding some more pads between the the metal frame and timber planks in an effort to remove the vibration totally. Notwithstanding my issue, the product is of a high quality and I have no regrets in its purchase.
